content.text: Six seconds, realistic historical film, continue the EXACT first-person shot in image 1. The viewer already holds the SAME folded paper securely by its lower corners. Ownership has already transferred: the man NEVER takes the paper back or hands it over again. The camera sees ONLY the blank, unmarked paper reverse, identical fibers and folds to image 1. Never turn the written front towards the camera. 0-1 seconds hold this same position. 1-3 seconds the grey-robed man leans forward slightly and brings his right index finger around the top edge to indicate a location on the OPPOSITE side of this same paper; from the camera only the fingertip near the top edge is visible, never penetrating the sheet. 3-4 seconds he retracts his hand completely. 4-6 seconds the viewer continues to hold the same blank reverse, gentle natural breathing motion. One ordinary sheet, two normal viewer hands, one normal pointing hand, no duplicate fingers. Same man's face and black head wrap, same linen tent and bed, same light and perspective. The mouth is closed throughout, no speech, no narrator, no vocal sound. Only paper and cloth rustles with gentle tent wind. No music/BGM/score. No writing, ink, letters, numbers, diagrams, frames, subtitles, labels, cards, UI, masks, blur patches, mosaic, shadows used for concealment, black boxes or overlays. No cut, no loop, no reverse.
